source.derivation: Lossless PNG encoding of the left 6446-pixel hemisphere from the original 12892x6446 equirectangular panorama; no resize or quality reduction.
source.creator: NOIRLab

runtime.structureFirstInputAdapter: Canonical 1:1 half-sphere ERP accepted; LucidFrame partial-panorama normalization retained.

limitations: The unobserved hemisphere is not measured and must not be used as verified tactical geometry.
A single camera center cannot reveal surfaces hidden behind foreground objects.
The sample validates half-sphere panorama reconstruction, not cross-room connectivity.
